description: Change Asana without opening Asana — custom fields, sections, start dates, rich notes, bulk. PAT.
name: io.github.jtalk22/asana-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Asana Personal Access Token (create at https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps). Optional when stored via `asana-mcp --setup` (macOS Keychain or ~/.asana-mcp.json).
environmentVariables.name: ASANA_PAT

environmentVariables.description: Workspace GID. Optional — auto-detected when the token sees exactly one workspace.
environmentVariables.name: ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID

environmentVariables.description: Tool surface filter: all | read | write | comma-list of tool names.
environmentVariables.name: ASANA_MCP_TOOLS

title: Asana MCP Server
